name: Bundle of Crocolisk Skins
summary: In the Wetlands, hunters prepare crocolisk skins for Menethil Harbor. The hides are valuable trade goods for local leatherworkers.

sections.title: Wetlands Commerce and Domestic Strife
sections.body: Crocolisk hides are an essential trade good for coastal Menethil Harbor. Hunters gather and cure the tough, water-resistant skins in the Wetlands before sending them west to artisans such as James Halloran. Einar has gathered this bundle, but asks a traveler to carry it into town. He wants to avoid returning home to face the temper of his frustrated wife, Sida.

faq.q: What is the Bundle of Crocolisk Skins used for?
faq.answer: The bundle holds raw and cured marsh hides for James Halloran, a tanner in Menethil Harbor. He turns the skins into sturdy boots, belts, and leather armor suited to the Wetlands’ damp, flooded ground.

Hunter Einar gathered and bundled the skins in the marshes. He usually brings his trade goods into town himself, but asks passing travelers to carry this bundle so he can avoid an argument with his wife, Sida.

James Halloran is a working leatherworker and tanner based in the port town of Menethil Harbor. He buys raw and cured hides from marsh hunters and makes boots, cured leather, and practical gear for sailors, soldiers, and townspeople.

angles.text: As an Alliance traveler, you can see how hunters beyond Menethil Harbor supply materials that help equip its garrison and citizens for the harsh swamp.
